task.title: Choose a Guided scenario
task.shortdesc: Select the scenario that best matches the profile goal so Guided editor can present a useful starting point.

prereq.p: You know the profile purpose you want to support.

context.p: Scenarios keep the first pass task-oriented and make the baseline easier to explain during review.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Review the scenario choices and their plain-language descriptions.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Choose the scenario closest to the deployment goal.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Check the affected baseline summary before adding presets or CIS layers.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The profile starts from an intentional scenario instead of an accidental blank baseline.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the scenario is wrong, switch it before fine-tuning later steps.
